## Scope of change
Describe code, data sources, legal topics and affected routes.

## Release checklist
- [ ] Source URLs are official or independently corroborated; no copied third-party text.
- [ ] No private data, secrets, DGI materials or unrelated credentials are added.
- [ ] `content-checks`, `web-checks`, `approval-policy` and `docker-build-check` succeeded for the **final** commit SHA.
- [ ] Changed legal claims have effective-date and source review.
- [ ] No unverified court act or template has been labeled as an approved document.
- [ ] This PR does not deploy, merge itself, change DNS or enable production SEO.
- [ ] Coolify manual deploy will be considered separately after protected merge and rollback readiness.

**Do not merge until GitHub private branch protections and CI execution are available.**
